metrics.pipelineRangePercent: 100 * (maximum intensity - minimum intensity) / mean intensity across the no-filter, outlier-filter, error-filter and joint-filter consensus curves
metrics.jointVsNoFilterPercent: 100 * absolute(joint-filter intensity - no-filter intensity) / four-pipeline mean intensity
metrics.pointwiseDepartureZ: maximum absolute difference between each alternative consensus and the joint-filter consensus, divided by the joint-filter pointwise sigma

interpretation: The four curves share measurements and are not independent replications. Their envelope measures analysis-choice sensitivity and is not a confidence interval. Pointwise z diagnostics do not correct for correlation across q or multiple comparisons.
